description: This file is a shell script that automates the build, patch application, testing, and coverage analysis for the entservices-appgateway project. It sets up dependencies, clones repositories, applies patches, configures and builds various components (including Thunder, ThunderTools, and entservices-apis), constructs test binaries, runs tests, and generates coverage reports, specifically focusing on the AppGateway plugin sources and related testing infrastructure.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in PATH.

methods.description: Checks out a specific git ref or tag in a given directory.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if not present or reclones if forced, then checks out a specific ref.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch file to a repository directory, handling already applied patches gracefully.

methods.name: build_dir_configured

methods.name: is_component_installed

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_noinstall
